description: Binary XML documents written by XmlDictionaryWriter.CreateBinaryWriter of .NET Framework 4.8. 'vectors' holds whole documents with the XML text .NET's own binary reader gives for them. 'large' and 'sweep' hold hashes of documents too large or too many to store: 'sweep' varies the amount of data in front of a value, which decides whether the writer merges the value with the end of its element. Dictionary keys: even keys index 'static', odd keys 'session'.
